bio.text: Troy Stubbs, a Republican, has represented District 31 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 2022 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

He was born in Charleston, South Carolina, and earned a bachelor's degree in finance from the University of Alabama, a master's degree in sports administration from the University of Louisville, and a master's degree in secondary mathematics from Alabama State University.
His career experience includes co-owning Frios Gourmet Pops and working as a financial advisor with First Community Bank of Central Alabama.
